title: Add a crayon plant app icon
purpose: Give the Leaf browser and installed app a friendly plant icon that matches the crayon botanical artwork on the home screen.
changes: Created a warm cream, green, and terracotta wax-crayon illustration of a leafy potted plant.
Added 192px and 512px PNG variants with safe margins for standard and maskable app icon crops.
Connected the new icon to the web app manifest, browser favicon, and Apple touch icon metadata.

tests.name: npm.cmd run build
tests.details: Vite build completed; the existing large-chunk warning remains.

tests.name: Icon asset inspection
tests.details: Verified the generated icon visually at 192px and 512px and confirmed both files are square PNGs referenced by the production manifest.

next_actions: Deploy and verify the public icon and manifest URLs.
